_doc: Console messages that are KNOWN NOISE in any stack — the browser itself, extensions, generic dev tooling, common third-party analytics, the sweep's own guard. A match is reported under 'Console noise (ignored)' with its count, never graded. Stack-specific noise (your analytics vendor, your identity provider's dev banner, your UI framework's dev-mode notices, a support widget) belongs in the routes file's `console_noise` list, which is merged with this one. Add a pattern only when you can say what emits it; an app error hidden here is an outage nobody sees. `pattern` is a case-insensitive Python regex tested against the message text.

noise.why: a browser extension, not the app
the sweep's own read-only guard refusing a write

noise.pattern: resizeobserver loop (completed with undelivered notifications|limit exceeded)
